headline: Interest Rates Rising, Will Debt Burdens Grow?... Government Expands Support for Vulnerable Borrowers
summary: The government will expand financial support for vulnerable borrowers, small merchants and small and medium-sized enterprises as interest rates rise. It also plans to add 300 billion won to annual Sunshine Loan supply and raise Misogum microloan limits.
why: Rising interest rates increase debt-servicing costs for households and small firms, which can affect credit quality at banks and lenders.
